method: E07_aux_minutiae_cldice's trained ResShift (raw v2 prints, plain diffusion loss + minutiae + clDice terms), sampled CCDF-style with E09_ccdf's sampler (start, t0 and projection chosen on v2 val by E09's grid and rule, without the regression control). No retraining

model._note: E07's EMA weights at step 100,000, used as they are. Network and schedule are E02's (checked by reconstructor.py)

sweep._note: E09's grid (params.json 'sweep') minus the regression-control start; e02_x0 = the model's own one-call x0 estimate at t = T. Also scored: plain (y0, t0 = 15, no projection = the model's usual 15-step chain), the reference of the rule
sweep.selection: E09's rule (fpr/validation/ccdf_sweep.py select): highest mean genuine bozorth3 score on v2 val, among configs whose impostor p95 is not above plain's and whose val EER is at most plain's + 1 point; ties -> fewer steps
